layout.structure: Sidebar Layout (Left Fixed Sidebar + Scrollable Main Content)
layout.grid_system: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6

StatCard.description: A clean white card displaying a key metric.
StatCard.style: bg-white shadow-sm border border-slate-100 hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200

ModuleHeader.description: A vibrant gradient header for each section.
ModuleHeader.structure: div (Gradient BG) > h1 (White Text) + Breadcrumbs (White/80 Text)
ModuleHeader.style: rounded-xl p-8 mb-8 shadow-lg text-white relative overflow-hidden

StatusBadge.style: px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the Sidebar Layout as the root structure.
Use the 'ModuleHeader' component at the top of every page with the correct gradient.
Ensure all text in the Sidebar is legible against the dark background (slate-900).
Use 'Manrope' for all headings to give a modern tech feel.
Do not use generic blue for everything; strictly follow the module-specific gradients.
For charts, use Recharts with colors matching the module's theme.
Ensure the interface is in French as requested.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop' - no generic centered layouts.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical (p-8 instead of p-4).
Add micro-interactions (hover states, transitions) to all interactive elements.
